description: Turn the answer of the platform MCP tool build_token_launch_tx into unsigned transactions for YOUR wallet: EVM calls (approvals, then the launch) or a base64 Solana transaction. Sign and send them yourself, then call the platform MCP tool submit_launch_tx with the hash/signature.

launch.description: The whole answer of the platform MCP tool build_token_launch_tx (Transaction/Approvals or SolanaLaunch).

name: build_launch_tx
title: Build a token launch transaction
